label: Search a structure database with one structure (Foldseek web server)
description: One search of one structure database with one query structure file, on the public Foldseek web server. Retained as verified on 2026-11-21: the MMseqs2 server API documentation (StructureSearch_server_api_docs.html, read from https://search.mmseqs.com/docs/, sha256 d92fc43678b78eb8d251b20fb06a0b05ac3db904f875de1c32b3dd7bef9c00a2) and the requests made to https://search.foldseek.com (docs/plan/designs/a102_services.md, section 3; docs/plan/designs/a102_structure_search_episode.md). The service has no key, no login and no cancel operation.

result.reply: one object: type, mode, queries[], results[] (one per database: db, alignments[0][] hits)

parameters.label: The query structure
parameters.desc: multipart file field; one PDB (or mmCIF) structure file. A FASTA sequence is accepted as a ticket and ends in ERROR (verified: a102_services.md, section 3).

parameters.label: The structure database to search
parameters.desc: One value of the service's databases (GET /api/databases, field path). Offered: 'afdb-swissprot' (AlphaFold models of UniProt/Swiss-Prot) and 'pdb100' (experimental structures: the chains of the biological assemblies of the PDB; a hit is named from the chain's UniProt accession, see pdb_chain_proteins). 'cath50' is verified to exist and is added when its round is built.

parameters.label: The alignment mode
parameters.desc: Fixed. The documentation names the modes all and summary; the server also accepts 3diaa and tmalign (verified live, 2026-11-21); tmalign is the global TM-align mode in which score is the query-normalised TM-score x 100 and eval the mean TM-score (Foldseek README).

timing: The ticket carries no task times (reply: id and status only); the duration of a job is observed.
